dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge curve exhibiting a distinct inward parabolic inflection from the posterior dorsal ridge to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Large pixel radius classified as obtuse and rounded at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45 to 50-degree linear upward slope relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Horizontal base width is greater than vertical height, with an approximate ratio of 1.4:1.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smoothly convex semi-circular arc boundary forming a prominent, rounded melon profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust beak projection extending forward with visible delineation of upper and lower jaw pixels.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle approximately 135 degrees where the melon slope meets the rostrum base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent high-contrast white depigmented patch or scar located at the posterior insertion point of the dorsal fin; small white focal marking on the pectoral fin margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Deeply notched tail fluke with acute distal tips; pronounced cyan-toned mottling across the dorsal and lateral flanks.
